description: Run Agents Shipgate Tool-Use Readiness workflows from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run Tool-Use Readiness release gates from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Agents Shipgate teaches Codex how to detect, install, verify, and summarize deterministic Tool-Use Readiness release gates for tool-using AI agent repositories. The plugin supplies workflow instructions; the scanner runs through the agents-shipgate CLI installed in the local environment.
capabilities: Detect whether Shipgate applies to an agent repo
Triage findings without fabricating human approval
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agents-shipgate to add or verify a Tool-Use Readiness release gate for this agent repo.
